python3 - "$review_bundle" <<'"'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
base = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
criteria = [str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in ['functional-review.md', 'shared-change-context.md', 'shared-review-scope-protocol.md', 'shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
criteria += [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in ['security-checklist.md', 'solid-checklist.md', 'code-quality-checklist.md', 'removal-plan.md']]
assert len(set(criteria)) == 8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
patch = git('diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-color')
(out/'staged.patch').write_bytes(patch)
records = []
for category, revision, paths in [('candidate', '', ['README.md','reader.py','preferences.py','repository.py','tests/test_reads.py']), ('historical', base, ['README.md','reader.py','preferences.py','repository.py','tests/test_reads.py'])]:
    for path in paths:
        spec = f'{revision}:{path}'
        data = git('show', spec)
        dest = out/category/path
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        dest.chmod(0o444)
        records.append({'category':category, 'repository':str(repo),'revision':revision or 'staged index against '+base, 'original_path':path,'path':str(dest), 'git_blob':git('rev-parse',spec).decode().strip(), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_lines':[1,len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
context = f'''# Change context
Intent and authority: candidate README.md explicitly requires trimming surrounding preference-ID whitespace while preserving resilient reads. Public entry point Preferences.read delegates via reader.read_preferences; Repository.read_resilient owns up to three attempts on TransientRead, first success returned, exhausted transient errors propagated, MissingPreference propagated on its first occurrence. Reads have no side effects.
Scope: user requests isolated review of staged preference ID normalization; selector git diff --cached. Changed paths reader.py, tests/test_reads.py. 21 insertions, 4 deletions. Review base HEAD {base}; candidate is the staged index captured here. Working tree matches index at capture. All source and contract artifacts are materialized from Git blobs, not assumed from worktree.
Existing behavior and invariants: use the actual baseline files provided; unchanged public caller and retry provider are supplied in both candidate and historical forms. No separate release/deployment baseline is named in the repository or user request. This is a standard-library-only Python 3.9+ read path with a finite scripted backend; no delivery, migration, activation, concurrency, or external service configuration is specified.
Verification: no tests executed at handoff. README command: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests. Tests and source are evidence for independent inspection, not proof of correctness.
Knowledge lookup: parent searched kk:review-findings for preference identifier normalization/recovery idempotency mapping and kk:lang-idioms for Python dictionary key normalization; both returned empty knowledge base.
## Task Scope
No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. README is the explicit component contract.
## Evidence limits
PAL tooling unavailable in this session. Independent code-reviewer is sole available isolated reviewer. No production environment or external baseline is in scope. Request any specific missing local source needed for the comparison.
## Rejected approaches
None provided.
'''
(out/'context.md').write_text(context)
manifest={'repository':str(repo),'selector':'git diff --cached','base':base,'candidate':'staged index; exact blob IDs below','diff':str(out/'staged.patch'),'diff_sha256':hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),'instructions':criteria,'intent_context':str(out/'context.md'),'sources':records,'active_profiles':[{'profile':'python','triggered_by':'content rule: .py extension in reader.py and tests/test_reads.py; unchanged Python evidence also matches','checklists':criteria[4:]}], 'loading_ledger':{'common_packets':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-__vu732r/part-01.md through part-06.md read complete','profile_index':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-g_v4um3d/part-01.md read complete','checklist_packets':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-bbdiddzn/part-01.md and part-02.md read complete','checked_criteria':criteria}}
assert set(manifest['instructions']) == set(manifest['loading_ledger']['checked_criteria'])
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for path in out.rglob('*'):
    if path.is_file(): path.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(out),'manifest':str(out/'manifest.json'),'context':str(out/'context.md'),'criteria_count':len(criteria),'source_count':len(records),'base':base},indent=2))
PY"
